versions.content: When a CAN XL frame with SDU Type other than 03h is re- ceived, the CanIf shall compare the Acceptance Field , the Priority ID , the SDU Type , and the VCID to the CanIfXLAcceptanceField , CanIfXLPriorityId , CanIfXLSduType , and CanIfXLVcid configured in the CanIfRxPduXLParams of all CanIfRxPduCfg s. If a parameter is not configured in the CanIfRxPduXLParams , it matches any received value.
